players.product: solid-oxide fuel cells for data-center onsite power

quarterly_data.signal: Company statement (8-K Item 7.01) responding to a July 8, 2026 report by Hunterbrook Media, an outlet that disclosed it may hold positions that would profit from a decline in Bloom's stock price: Bloom said it has sufficient supply of scandium oxide to meet its current fuel cell demand and backlog, that its supply is not dependent on China and that it is also not dependent on China to scale scandium oxide to meet future demand growth. Bloom also said it has clear visibility into its supply chain to support production of 25GW of fuel cells per year and will continue to expand this capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: company statement: supply-chain visibility to support production of 25GW of fuel cells per year
